summary: Logistic Properties of the Americas filed a Form 6-K on August 12, 2026, announcing its second quarter 2026 earnings results. The filing is a routine earnings release, reporting financial and operating highlights such as 26.1% revenue growth and 27.0% NOI increase. No special-situation corporate event, such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring, is indicated. The filing is purely an interim financial disclosure for a foreign private issuer.
